RED-FIRST HANDOFF ARTIFACT — ful1334 Phase 2 containment invariants

Captured against the tree with Phase 1 landed (containment edges already carry
their chunk slots) but BEFORE the orphan-emission step and the slot-to-node-ID
pre-pass. Both tests COMPILE here: they call only Populate, kgtypes and existing
in-package helpers, no symbol this plan introduces.

Command:
  cd cmd/knowledge && CGO_ENABLED=1 go test ./internal/collector/parser/ \
    -run '^TestInvariant_(NoCrossFileContains|EveryChunkNodeIsContained)$' -v -count=1

Exit status: 1
Subtests: 12 run, 12 FAILED, 0 passed.

THE FAILURES ARE THE SPECIFIED DEFECT, NOT FIXTURE SETUP — each names a concrete
offender, so a fixture that broke for a setup reason would be distinguishable:

  TestInvariant_NoCrossFileContains — names the cross-file pair:
    web/Banner.tsx      contains web/Banner.test.tsx:Banner  (lives in web/Banner.test.tsx)
    svc/a.go            contains svc/b.go:init               (lives in svc/b.go)
    cmd/alpha/main.go   contains cmd/beta/main.go:main       (lives in cmd/beta/main.go)
    scripts/a.test.sh   contains scripts/b.test.sh:fail      (lives in scripts/b.test.sh)
    bin/one.py          contains bin/two.py:main             (lives in bin/two.py)

  Two cases trip the KNOWN-POSITIVE CONTROL instead, which is the same defect in
  its other form — the colliding endpoint is dropped rather than mis-bound, so
  the file ends up with no containment at all:
    e2e/one.fixture.ts  produced no file-to-symbol CONTAINS edge at all
    tools/one.mjs       produced no file-to-symbol CONTAINS edge at all

  TestInvariant_EveryChunkNodeIsContained — names the uncontained node per cause:
    orphans (yaml)          deploy/app.yaml:L1-1     block_mapping_pair
    orphans (go const/var)  cfg/values.go:L3-7       const_declaration
    orphans (bash command)  scripts/run.sh:L2-2      command
    unnamed declaration     src/lib.c:L3-3           declaration
    unnamed test block      spec/suite.spec.ts:L1-1  import_statement

THE RAW OUTPUT BELOW IS VERBATIM EXCEPT FOR ONE SUBSTITUTION. Each of the 12
"Error Trace:" lines carried the absolute path of the worktree the capture ran
in; that prefix is removed and the repo-relative path testify already prints on
the line above it is left in its place. A shipped artifact carries no personal
identifiers or paths, and this file is copied into the public mirror. Nothing
else was touched: every FAIL line, every subtest name, every offender pair and
every assertion message is byte-for-byte as captured.
